title: Pure Branded
summary: Fallen of Albaz with its Branded Spells and Traps, the Despia monsters built alongside them, and the Fusions that name Albaz, plus generic staples. The page's combo lines add Dogmatika, Tri-Brigade and Swordsoul cards, so they use cards this list leaves out. Aluber and Branded Opening find each other, Albaz and Branded Fusion turn into Level 8 Fusions, and every Fusion sent to the GY pays you back at the End Phase. Branded Fusion locks the Extra Deck to Fusions, so it's Fusions only. The Branded pages open this same list.
main: Fallen of Albaz
Summoned: discards a card to Fusion Summon using itself and a monster on either field.
Fallen of the White Dragon
2026 support that counts as Fallen of Albaz: sends an Albaz Fusion from the Extra Deck to summon itself from the hand. Its Ecclesia summon needs Dogmatika cards this build leaves out.
Aluber the Jester of Despia
Summoned: searches a Branded Spell/Trap; comes back from the GY to negate a monster when your Fusion is removed.
Despian Tragedy
Sent to the GY or banished by an effect: searches a Despia monster; from the GY, Sets a Branded Spell/Trap.
Albaz the Ashen
Counts as Fallen of Albaz, grows with your GY, and shields your other monsters from targeting.
Dramaturge of Despia
Negates a monster whenever an Extra Deck monster arrives; returns after being used as Fusion material.
Ad Libitum of Despia
Used as Fusion material, revives a Despia or Level 8 Fusion.
Branded Fusion
Limited. Fusion Summons an Albaz Fusion using two monsters from the hand, Deck or field.
Branded Opening
Discards to add or summon a Despia monster from the Deck.
Branded in Red
Returns a Despia or Albaz from the GY to the hand, then Fusion Summons by banishing materials.
Branded in High Spirits
Semi-Limited. Sends a Level 8 Fusion from the Extra Deck to search Fallen of Albaz or a monster that names it.
The Fallen & The Virtuous
2025 support. Sends an Albaz Fusion from the Extra Deck to destroy a card.
Branded Lost
Makes your Fusion Summons unanswerable and searches an Albaz card when you Fusion Summon.
Despia, Theater of the Branded
Field Spell: Fusion Summons a Level 8+ Fusion, and revives one when a Fairy leaves the field.
Branded Retribution
Counter Trap: returns Albaz Fusions to negate a summoning effect.
Branded Banishment
Revives a Despia or Level 8 Fusion, then Fusion Summons with the opponent's monsters.
extra: Mirrorjade the Iceblade Dragon
Sends an Albaz Fusion from the Extra Deck to banish a monster on either turn; leaving the field, wipes their monsters.
Albion the Branded Dragon
Albaz + a LIGHT monster: Fusion Summons again on arrival; sent to the GY, adds or Sets a Branded Spell/Trap from the Deck at the End Phase.
Titaniklad the Ash Dragon
Albaz + a 2500+ ATK monster; in the GY, fetches Fallen of Albaz at the End Phase.
Lubellion the Searing Dragon
Albaz + a DARK monster: Fusion Summons again by shuffling materials.
Alba-Lenatus the Abyss Dragon
Albaz + Dragons by contact; attacks once per material.
Rindbrumm the Striking Dragon
Negates an Extra Deck monster's effect and bounces a monster.
Brigrand the Glory Dragon
Can't be destroyed by battle; in the GY, fetches Fallen of Albaz at the End Phase.
Sprind the Irondash Dragon
Clears its column; in the GY, fetches Fallen of Albaz at the End Phase.
Despian Quaeritis
Zeroes every monster's ATK except Level 8 Fusions.
Despian Proskenion
Steals or banishes an Extra Deck monster from the opponent's GY.
Albion the Sanctifire Dragon
Albaz + a LIGHT Spellcaster: can't be targeted; revives two monsters, one to each field, on their turn.
The Dragon that Devours the Dogma
Albaz + a LIGHT or DARK monster + an Effect Monster: shuffles GY and banished cards back.
